title: Graph Neural Networks for Recommendation Systems
content: Graph neural networks can model users items and their relationships as graphs for personalized recommendation.

title: Transformer Models for Natural Language Processing
content: Transformers use attention mechanisms to understand context in text and power modern language models.

title: Vector Databases for Semantic Search
content: Vector databases store embeddings and allow fast similarity search across large collections of text images or products.

title: Collaborative Filtering in Recommendation Engines
content: Collaborative filtering recommends items based on user behavior patterns and similarities between users or items.

title: Retrieval Augmented Generation for Question Answering
content: Retrieval augmented generation combines search with language models to answer questions using external knowledge.

title: Hybrid Search in Modern AI Systems
content: Hybrid search combines keyword search and semantic search to improve retrieval accuracy.

title: Explainable AI for Recommendation Systems
content: Explainable recommendation systems help users understand why a particular item was suggested.

title: FAISS for Large Scale Similarity Search
content: FAISS is used for efficient nearest neighbor search over high dimensional embedding vectors.
